title: Concept: Redis INFO output served in a response
description: Redis INFO reports the build version, uptime, connected clients, memory ceiling and eviction policy in one page. That is enough to pick the matching exploit path for the exact build and to judge how much load the instance will take before it degrades.
applicability: Responses from a cache host, a proxy that forwards its port, or an application endpoint that shells out to redis-cli.
risk: The caller fingerprints the exact Redis build and its limits, and confirms that the data store is reachable from their position.
